subject: SummitWell: clarification on Art.28/30 access and DPIA deliverables
messages:
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@summitwell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barlow <tom.barlow@summitwell.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: DPIA and Art.28/30 access — what we need from Redwood

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the call earlier — SummitWell is moving toward a security review with our legal/compliance team and we need to consolidate the materials Redwood will provide for our DPIA and Art.28/30 exhibit. Can you confirm the following items and expected delivery timing: 

- A single PDF that explains the flow of patient-identifiable data through Redwood services (high level processing map) suitable for our DPIA annex.
- An extract of the Article 30 register fields we can include in our submission (redacted example OK).
- Confirmation of audit rights (contact, scope, anticipated lead times) and whether remote evidence collection is an option.
- A snapshot of subprocessor list as of the time of onboarding (and whether you offer an up-to-date ledger export).

We have a tight window (internal deadline 2027-12-07). Also attaching a short template for the access matrix we prefer.

Attachments: summitwell_scope_request.pdf (PDF), access_matrix_template.csv (CSV)

Best,
Elena Morris
Head of Privacy Operations
SummitWell Health
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@summitwell.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Nov 2027 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPIA and Art.28/30 access — what we need from Redwood

Hi Elena,

Thanks for the clear list and the template — very helpful. High level answers up front and then a proposed delivery plan below.

Short answers: 
- Processing map: yes, we can produce a concise PDF (diagram + narrative) that describes data flows for SummitWell-specific integration.
- Article 30 extract: we can provide a CSV export with the main register fields (controller/processor roles, categories of data, retention, legal basis, subprocessor references) — we'll redact internal PII.
- Audit rights + evidence: our standard DPA allows remote evidence collection and scoped onsite audits with advance notice; for SummitWell we can provide remote evidence (logs, config snapshots, and selected artifact exports) within 5 business days for routine requests and discuss expedited windows for regulatory audits.
- Subprocessor snapshot: we maintain a ledger and can export a time-stamped snapshot.

Proposed timeline: 
1) By 2027-12-01: send the processing map draft + Article 30 sample export.
2) By 2027-12-03: provide the subprocessor ledger snapshot and list of likely evidence sources.
3) Week of 2027-12-06: alignment call to walk the evidence and agree any redaction rules.

Action items from us: Karthik will confirm what log slices we can export (KMS wrap logs, access ledger, and Art.30 register export path). Soojin will prepare the processing-diagram draft and coordinate the ledger snapshot.

If this timeline works for you, Elena, we'll start assembling the artifacts.

Best regards,
Irene Choi
Senior Privacy Counsel
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@summitwell.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2027 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: DPIA and Art.28/30 access — what we need from Redwood

Elena / team — following up on specific evidence types. For clarity, here are what we can extract and expected SLAs: 

- Article 30 register export: full CSV extract (field list: processing activity id, purpose, categories of personal data, processing operations, data recipients, retention, lawful basis, technical/organisational measures). Delivery: 1 business day after request.
- Access/Provisioning ledger: time-windowed export of tokens/ticket granting (useful for DPIA evidence). Delivery: 3 business days for a 3-month slice, 5+ days for wider ranges.
- KMS wrap/unwrapping logs: we can export metadata for wrap/unwrap events for customer keys; redacted to remove internal identifiers. Note: raw HSM audit traces are restricted — we'll provide summarized entries. Delivery: 5 business days.
- Network/dataflow diagram artifacts: Soojin will generate the diagram; I'll provide the mapping table between product components and the Article 30 fields.

We should document the redaction approach up front (we redact internal operator IDs, full IP addresses beyond /24, and internal hostnames). If SummitWell needs something more granular, we'll need a signed non-disclosure amendment before we share raw traces.

—Karthik
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morris <elena.morris@summitwell.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Processing map draft + Article30 sample attached

Hi Elena — attaching the first-pass artifacts for your DPIA annex. Highlights: 

- processing_map_summitwell_v1.pdf: a two-page diagram (ingest -> inference -> logging -> retention) with a short narrative and retention counters for each processing container.
- article30_sample_summitwell.csv: a masked export of the Article 30 register with the fields Karthik mentioned.

Note on subprocessor snapshot: I've exported a time-stamped ledger entry (not attached here) and can drop the ledger CSV to your Drive link if you confirm access rights for privacy@summitwell.com.

Attachments: processing_map_summitwell_v1.pdf (PDF), article30_sample_summitwell.csv (CSV)

Next steps I propose: a 30-minute call on Thurs 2027-12-02 to walk the artifacts and confirm redaction rules. Please send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Privacy Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Morris <elena.morris@summitwell.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Barlow <tom.barlow@summitwell.com>, privacy@summitwell.com
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Processing map draft + Article30 sample attached

Thanks, Irene / Soojin / Karthik — this is great and exactly the level we need. Wedged in a quick confirmation: Thursday 2027-12-02 at 10:00 PT works for a 30-minute walk-through. I'll send the invite and include our compliance lead (privacy@summitwell.com). 

Two small asks before the call: 
- Can you confirm whether the Article 30 export includes the last-processed date for each processing activity? That helps our retention validation.
- For the access ledger export, can you scope it to the last 90 days by default? That should be sufficient for this audit.

If you can confirm those two points in the invite thread, we will be ready for the call.

Best,
Elena
